objective: Give settlement analysts a same-day break queue they can scan, prioritise, and clear without guessing consequence.
primaryTask: Understand account health and act on the highest-risk unmatched transaction.
audience: Operations analysts resolving payment breaks under a same-day deadline
visualThesis: Numeric urgency and unmatched state outrank chrome: dense tabular scanning, cool restrained surfaces, and one accent reserved for the next decisive action.
observed: Existing product uses cool neutrals and a single blue accent
Primary work surface is a filterable transaction table
inferred: Analysts compare many rows before acting, so density beats marketing whitespace
constraints: Must reuse the shared design-system token set
Dark theme required for overnight ops shifts

surfaces.elevation: two levels; overlays and raised controls only

components.name: BreakAgeBar
components.responsibility: Encode time remaining to cut-off inside each row

components.name: RiskQueueTable
components.responsibility: Scan, filter, and open unmatched breaks

states.empty: single explanatory line plus reset-filters action

responsiveRules.wide: summary and table side by side
responsiveRules.mobile: priority columns only; secondary metrics behind row expand
responsiveRules.rationale: Preserve risk priority on narrow widths
Secondary trends must not displace the action queue

motion.interruption: cancel in-flight transitions immediately on new navigation
motion.reducedMotion: instant state changes with equivalent focus and status cues

nonGoals: A second accent for secondary actions
